verdict.rationale: Gram lets a developer build and deploy their own MCP server from an OpenAPI document or TypeScript Functions, and push it with the CLI. Within an organization it can be distributed through an approved-tools catalog, bundled into plugins targeted at chosen recipients, and installed into agents via the CLI. Discovery and distribution appear limited to the org or team, though: the registry integration only imports third-party servers and does not publish to them. Missing for 10: public publishing or marketplace listing for external users, evidence of publishing to the MCP Registry, independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish-to-install flow.
